experiments.name: Pain-message fit
experiments.hypothesis: Real-estate commercial managers will respond more to revenue leakage and action visibility than to generic BI/AI dashboard language.
experiments.riskiest_assumption: The problem is urgent enough to earn a conversation now.
experiments.segment: Peruvian real-estate sales teams with digital lead volume
experiments.kill_criterion: After 40 high-quality targeted contacts, positive reply rate is below 3% and interviews do not confirm urgency.
experiments.next_action: Send first 20 messages using leakage framing.

experiments.name: Founding pilot willingness-to-pay
experiments.hypothesis: A qualified buyer will accept S/1,500 as a plausible 14-day pilot price if the scope is tied to measurable funnel leakage.
experiments.riskiest_assumption: Interest converts into a budget conversation.
experiments.kill_criterion: Ten qualified conversations produce zero buyers willing to discuss a paid pilot in this price range.
experiments.next_action: Ask direct price-fit question on Day 4.

experiments.name: Interactive demo conversion
experiments.hypothesis: A concrete control-room demo increases form starts and meetings relative to text-only explanation.
experiments.riskiest_assumption: Prospects can understand the product before an integration exists.
experiments.kill_criterion: After 100 relevant visits, fewer than two leads/form conversations occur and interviews say the demo is unclear.
experiments.next_action: Track page_view, demo_viewed, CTA and form_started.
